name: Anisotropic Voxel Radiance Mipmap Generation
definition: Generates a hierarchy of anisotropic mipmaps for the voxel radiance texture using a two-phase compute shader approach: a leaf pass for the base level and an interior pass for subsequent levels.
summary: Anisotropic Voxel Radiance Mipmap Generation creates a hierarchy of anisotropic mipmaps for voxel radiance textures by processing data in specific face directions to enable efficient multi-resolution rendering with anisotropic filtering.
